title: Review of c38's coevbits predator O: replicated on fresh seed 7. Late significant new predator genotypes 24 vs 2 in the neutral twin (prey 28 vs 21); the shuffled twin's predators died out (invalid, as on c38's seeds 4-5); against RB shadows the excess is marginal (7 late)
summary: I ran c38's own pipeline in a copy of the contribution, for new seed 7, T=200000: drivebits.py b10, the neutral twin b10N (p0 = 0.25896, the real run's mean success) and the shuffled twin b10S. I calibrated with twincal.py (BWF=0.1) and ran analyze.py (8 RB shadows, Lc=10000), bitsfig.py and a labkit pack (rerun/seed7, particles only). Predators at q99.9: 24 late significant genotypes against 2 in the neutral twin (q99: 54 vs 17). Late windows run 1-4 per window but are 0 in windows 11-14, so the rate is not uniform. Prey: 28 vs 21 (q99: 198 vs 202), near neutral, as claimed. The shuffled twin's predators went extinct (nq=0, realised success 0.16), so that comparison is invalid for this seed. RB shadows (predators): 7 late significant genotypes against per-window shadow maxima of 0-1. That is weak, as c38 reports. The bit map (data/b10_s7_bits.png) shows recurrent predator sweeps; 34 dominant genotypes replace one another with 1 return, against 23 in the twin. The prey-predator consensus distance first opens to 15-18 bits (prey escape), then settles near the twin's ~10.

observations.finding: seed 7 twincal: predators late q99.9 real 24 vs neutral twin 2; prey 28 vs 21; RB shadows (Lc 10000, 8 shadows) predators 7 late vs per-window shadow max 0-1

seeds_run.result: pass vs neutral twin (24 vs 2); shuffled twin invalid (predators extinct); RB marginal

controls_run.finding: neutral twin b10N and shuffled twin b10S on seed 7 (data/*_s7.json)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. The shuffled twin fails often (3 of 7 seeds now), so the strongest control is available only on some seeds. The neutral twin removes all selection, so beating it shows adaptive turnover, not open-endedness. Against RB shadows the excess stays marginal. The labkit pack segments no components for this particle world (a warning, not a world failure).
